family.amstrad-pc2000.description: The professional range combining an entry model with VGA-equipped 286 and 386 workstations.
family.amstrad-pc2000.history: Announced in September 1988, the PC2000 series expanded Amstrad's professional range: the PC2086 at entry level, the PC2286 in the middle and the PC2386 for demanding workstation users. They shared VGA, a mouse and a choice of monitors; storage and expansion distinguished the tiers. The April 1989 brochure places design in the UK and computer assembly in Korea. In September 1989, Dataquest attributes PC2286 and PC2386 manufacture to GPT in Kirkcaldy, Scotland. Both references are retained; they do not identify the factory for each production batch.
